temporal_provenance_counterexample.title: Making Neural Programming Architectures Generalize via Recursion
temporal_provenance_counterexample.review_evidence: The meta-review states that topological sort and quicksort were added based on reviewer discussion.
temporal_provenance_counterexample.pdf_evidence: The preserved PeerRead PDF explicitly presents four tasks: addition, bubble sort, topological sort, and quicksort.
temporal_provenance_counterexample.implication: At least one accepted PeerRead PDF is a post-review revised manuscript rather than the submission-time paper state.

reason: The source contains real conference submissions and real decisions, but preserved PDFs are not uniformly submission-time. A post-review revised accepted PDF is directly demonstrated, so the corpus cannot serve as the neutral T0 substrate required by the frozen protocol.
